senses.gloss:
पुट् पुट्, i. 6, Par. † To embrace.
 --† i. 1, Par. To grind, to pound (v. r.).
 --† i. 10, पुटय, Par. To fasten, to bind together.
 --† i. 10, पोटय, Par.
 1. To speak or shine.
 2. To reduce to powder, to grind.
 3. To be small.
 --With the prep. परि परि, pass. To peel, to lose the skin, Suśr. 1, 302, 14.
† पुट्ट् पुट्ट्, i. 10, Par. To be small.

पुट पुट, m., f. टी, and n.
 1. A concavity.
 2. A cup or concavity made of a leaf folded or doubled, MBh. 9, 2827.
 3. A shallow cup or receptacle, as the hollow of the hand, Pañc. 44, 24.
 4. A vessel, or basket made of leaves, Man. 6, 28.
 5. A cover, a covering, [] Utt. Rāmac. 50, 8.
 6. A cloth worn to cover the privities.
 II. m. A horse's hoof.
 --Comp.

पुटक पुट + क, n. and f. टिका (Pañc. 265, 5),
 1. A concavity.
 2. A bag or vessel or concavity made of a leaf doubled over in a funnel-like shape, Rājat. 1, 213.
 --Comp.
पुट- + भेदन पुट- + भेदन, n. a town, MBh. 1, 3978.
